content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NIO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Apprentice Trainee.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies available for the Apprentice Trainee posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Technician Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Three Years Diploma in Civil, Electrical & Electronics, or Computer Engineering/IT or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Graduate Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentice posts offer a salary of Rs. 12,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue details.
